## QuickBooks Invoice Sync
Monthly sync of QuickBooks invoices to Google Sheets with email reconciliation report.

**Setup:**
1. Replace YOUR_COMPANY_ID in the QuickBooks API URL
2. Set OAuth2 bearer token in HTTP Header Auth
3. Connect Google Sheets for accounting export
4. Configure Gmail for monthly reconciliation reports
5. Adjust schedule as needed (default: every 4 weeks)
